description: Estimate company/corporate income tax on an annual profit at the headline rate for 139 countries (28 verified against the national authority; the rest are indicative OECD headline rates, and the answer says "not verified — confirm with" the authority). Use it for company profit questions; individuals belong to income_tax_estimate. smallBusiness applies the small-company rate only where it covers all of the company's income (AU, IN); where the reduced rate is a profit band (UK small profits, the Canadian small-business deduction and similar) it is noted, not applied. Headline-rate arithmetic only: state and provincial tax, surcharges and marginal relief are named in the note, not computed. Each answer cites the company-tax source and date — not the GST/VAT one. A negative profit returns an explanation (losses carry forward), never a negative tax; a country not covered says so.

country.description: 2-letter ISO code of a covered country (upper case)

profit.description: Annual taxable profit in local currency; a negative value (a loss) returns an explanatory message instead of tax

smallBusiness.description: Apply the small-company rate — honoured only where it covers all income (AU, IN); elsewhere the reduced rate is noted instead

name: company_tax_estimate

dataVerifiedOn.description: ISO date the rate data was last confirmed against the authority

disclaimer.description: General-information note that must accompany any figure shown to a person

effectiveFrom.description: ISO date the rate set in use took effect

mayBeStale.description: True once the verification date is over a year old — re-confirm with the authority

note.description: What the headline calculation excludes (state/provincial tax, surcharge/cess, marginal relief …)

rateApplied.description: Rate actually applied, as a fraction

smallCompanyRate.description: The small-company rate on file, when there is one

source.description: The national tax authority the figures were verified against (e.g. 'ATO — ato.gov.au')

sourceUrl.description: https link to the authority page the rate was verified against. Present only on rate answers backed by a verified ledger row — absent (never empty) otherwise, so its presence is itself the claim

standardRate.description: The standard (headline) rate, as a fraction

tax.description: Company tax on the profit (local currency, rounded)

taxLabel.description: The country's name for the tax, e.g. 'Corporation Tax'

usedSmallRate.description: Whether the small-company rate was applied

title: Company tax estimate (139 countries)
